doubt_decisions: Removed duplicated cotefile marker. Resolved Sup twice, esp., top., str. top., cancelled de, figure, partie and est. Replaced the opening insertion by passage/pass. ge à une and the cancelled sign by leq/in; retained uncertainty for plural fermés. Reordered lower bound to 0/-1, margin l’axiome/l’énoncé and par ordinaire/par ordre/pour ordre from enlarged ink. Retained old date 14/4, old es, F alphabet, old figur, one physically obliterated word after ou, portant, la/le, old connexé/connexe and both ou, cancelled connectivity explanation, every obscured word of cancelled NB, and P alphabet. Family notation harmonized visually; no mathematical correction made.
unresolved: The cancelled diagonal NB is especially uncertain: its short words must not be quoted as an established sentence. The underlined qualification after partie fermée, initial connectivity bound, and opening insertion remain uncertain. Boundary delta/partial shape is reserved for second visual audit.
